title: a16z Podcast: Giving and Getting Feedback -- for Bosses and Employees

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: There's feedback and there's guidance; there's praise and there's criticism.
reader_summary.overview: There's feedback and there's guidance; there's praise and there's criticism. All of it is important to do better work. -- the way we give and receive feedback really matters. "One of the great things about having a great boss," observes Kim Scott, "is that a great boss will help you grow as a person.

key_points.text: All of it is important to do better work.
And for a lot of people, a big part of what gives work meaning is personal growth." That's another reason why feedback matters.
But doesn't so much feedback take too much time when you're busy building things.
